content:
**Tightly Wound** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *CAMP Revamp* update.

Reduces weapons spin-up time.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Weapons spin up 60% faster. | 0031AF10 | 

Before update 62, the perk provided +10%/+15%/20% damage to one-handed melee weapons and was named "Expert Heavy Gunner."
